k.q: Use selection to describe a connection between two geographically separate school LANs.
k.code:
separateSites = true
if separateSites then
    print("Use a WAN link between LANs")
else
    print("One site: local LAN")
endif
p: Explain why two sites may need a WAN and why distance alone cannot classify every network.
k.a: With separateSites true, output is Use a WAN link between LANs. With false, output is One site: local LAN. A WAN can connect LANs across separate geographical sites; actual classification involves scale, infrastructure and network management, rather than an arbitrary distance threshold. This is an illustrative decision.

e: Explain one difference between LAN and WAN. [2 marks]
LAN covers smaller/local area; WAN connects over wide geographical areas.
Give one advantage of client-server networking. [2 marks]
Centralised user account, access or resource management.
Explain one drawback of peer-to-peer for a large school. [3 marks]
Harder to centrally manage permissions, security or backups across many devices.
v: Covers a small geographical area such as one building, usually under a single organisation.
Connects networks over wider geographical areas, often via third-party infrastructure.
Central servers provide resources/services for client devices.
Devices share resources directly without a dedicated central server for those resources.
x: A WAN can connect LANs in geographically separate locations.
r: Calculate the denary value of unsigned binary 10101010.
Explain why index 4 is invalid for a four-element zero-indexed array.
Valid indexes are 0,1,2,3; index 4 is out of bounds.
Correct: 'ROM loses its data when power is removed'.
ROM is non-volatile; contents remain without power.

Run/test with expected normal and boundary cases, and compare outcomes.

mastery.task: Design a network recommendation algorithm with two inputs: are offices in different towns, and is central administration required? Suggest WAN vs LAN connections and client-server vs peer-to-peer.
mastery.hint: Use independent tests; don't treat physical distance as the sole rule.
mastery.answer: Across towns calls for connected LANs via WAN; central user administration favours client-server. Test same building with/without central management.
